verdict.rationale: Supabase publishes a documented Management API with an OpenAPI 3.0 spec for managing organizations, projects, branches, and configuration. A probe confirmed the spec is live at supabase.com/openapi.json, and llms.txt points agents to it. Each project also gets auto-generated REST and GraphQL data APIs with type generation, and checks like Advisors are documented as reachable through the Management API. Missing for 10: quoted Management API reference detail (auth model, endpoint coverage, rate limits) and independent hands-on reports of driving the product through it.
